lines.zh: 它的皮肤在黑暗中闪烁着诡异的绿光。
lines.en: Its skin glows with an eerie green in the darkness.

lines.zh: 冰冷的呼吸在它身边盘旋。
lines.en: Cold breath swirls around its form.

lines.zh: 它缓慢地爬行着，每一步都发出微弱的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: It moves slowly, making a faint hiss with each step.

lines.zh: 巨大的石质躯体在岩壁上缓慢移动。
lines.en: Its massive stone form slowly moves along the rock wall.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛似乎能洞察一切。
lines.en: Its eyes seem to see through everything.

lines.zh: 洞穴深处传来了它的脚步声。
lines.en: Footsteps echo from deep within the cave.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着饥饿的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with a hungry light.

lines.zh: 岩石在它脚下崩裂。
lines.en: Rock crumbles beneath its feet.

lines.zh: 它紧盯着你，等待时机。
lines.en: It fixes you with a gaze, waiting for the right moment.

lines.zh: 它的触手在黑暗中寻找猎物。
lines.en: Its tentacles search for prey in the darkness.

lines.zh: 石像的关节碾碎碎石，缓缓挪动。
lines.en: Its stone joints grind the gravel as it shifts.

lines.zh: 雕像挪一步，洞穴就静一分。
lines.en: Each step of the statue makes the cave a little quieter.

lines.zh: 它静静地站立，仿佛一尊活的雕像。
lines.en: It stands still, like a living statue.

lines.zh: 它的目光空洞，仿佛无尽的黑暗。
lines.en: Its gaze is hollow, like endless darkness.

lines.zh: 它缓慢地呼吸，发出微弱的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: It breathes slowly, making a faint hiss.

lines.zh: 它的触手轻轻触碰周围的石头。
lines.en: Its tentacles gently touch the surrounding rocks.

lines.zh: 它沉默地注视着，似乎在思考。
lines.en: It silently stares, as if in thought.

lines.zh: 它的皮肤上布满了裂纹。
lines.en: Cracks mar its skin.

lines.zh: 它似乎在观察周围的动静。
lines.en: It seems to be watching for movement.

lines.zh: 它的触手在空气中轻轻颤动。
lines.en: Its tentacles tremble lightly in the air.

lines.zh: 它无声地呼吸着，显得异常安静。
lines.en: It breathes silently, unnaturally still.

lines.zh: 它的目光突然转向你。
lines.en: Its gaze suddenly shifts to you.

lines.zh: 它站在矿洞岔口，像在数你的心跳。
lines.en: It stands at the mineshaft fork as if counting your heartbeats.

lines.zh: 石壳下的东西换了姿势，又静止。
lines.en: Something under the stone shell shifts, then goes still.

lines.zh: 几天过去，它才决定醒来。
lines.en: Days pass before it decides to wake.

lines.zh: 它以雕像的姿势，等了几十年。
lines.en: It has waited decades in the pose of a statue.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛突然闪烁，锁定你的位置。
lines.en: Its eyes flicker, locking onto your position.

lines.zh: 它缓缓转动头部，寻找你的身影。
lines.en: It slowly turns its head to seek you.

lines.zh: 它的触手触碰你留下的脚印。
lines.en: Its tentacles touch the footprints you left.

lines.zh: 它紧盯着你，准备发起攻击。
lines.en: It fixes you with a stare, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸变得急促，似乎发现了你。
lines.en: Its breath quickens, as if it has detected you.

lines.zh: 它的身体开始微微震颤。
lines.en: Its body begins to tremble slightly.

lines.zh: 它仿佛预知了你的动作。
lines.en: It seems to predict your movements.

lines.zh: 它的目光紧盯着你的动作。
lines.en: Its gaze is fixed on your movements.

lines.zh: 它的触手突然伸向你。
lines.en: Its tentacles suddenly reach for you.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛散发出警告的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes emit a warning glow.

lines.zh: 它的石眼转向你，没有眨眼。
lines.en: Its stone eyes turn to you without blinking.

lines.zh: 你抬头，发现雕像正俯视你。
lines.en: You look up and find the statue gazing down at you.

lines.zh: 它记住了你火把的光。
lines.en: It has memorized the light of your torch.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声被它数清了。
lines.en: It has counted every one of your footsteps.

lines.zh: 它侧过脸，洞穴的风停了。
lines.en: It turns its face, and the cave wind stops.

lines.zh: 石缝里的目光贴上了你的后颈。
lines.en: A gaze from the cracks settles on the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 它今天第一次转动脖子。
lines.en: For the first time today, it turns its neck.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，它就更近一寸。
lines.en: Every step you retreat, it gains an inch.

lines.zh: 它把下巴挪向你所在的方向。
lines.en: It slides its chin toward where you stand.

lines.zh: 石像面朝你，裂口里透出微光。
lines.en: The statue faces you, a faint light in its cracks.

lines.zh: 声音渐弱，嘶嘶声越来越小。
lines.en: Sighs, the hiss fades away.

lines.zh: 痛苦地嘶叫，声音低沉。
lines.en: Groans painfully, a low sound.

lines.zh: 痛苦中发出沙哑的叫声。
lines.en: Hisses weakly, a raspy sound.

lines.zh: 喉咙嘶哑，痛苦地喘息。
lines.en: Suffocating, gasps painfully.

lines.zh: 发出微弱的嘶嘶声，似乎在痛哭。
lines.en: Whimpers softly, almost a sob.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中夹杂着低声的呢喃。
lines.en: Hisses, with low mumbling.

lines.zh: 痛苦中发出刺耳的叫声。
lines.en: Screams painfully, sharp sounds.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声间歇，显得更加虚弱。
lines.en: Hisses sporadically, weaker.

lines.zh: 发出微弱的嘶嘶声，似乎在呻吟。
lines.en: Whimpers softly, like in pain.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声渐弱，仿佛要窒息。
lines.en: Hisses fading, like choking.

lines.zh: 你靠近了我，我会保护自己。
lines.en: You come near, and I will protect myself.

lines.zh: 别想伤害我。
lines.en: Do not harm me.

lines.zh: 接近我，你会后悔的。
lines.en: Get closer, and you'll regret it.

lines.zh: 你闻起来很美味。
lines.en: You smell delicious.

lines.zh: 我不会让你靠近的。
lines.en: I won't let you get close.

lines.zh: 你已经足够接近了。
lines.en: You are close enough.

lines.zh: 不要试图伤害我。
lines.en: Do not try to harm me.

lines.zh: 我的存在是对你的警告。
lines.en: My presence is a warning to you.

lines.zh: 你不能吃我。
lines.en: You cannot eat me.

lines.zh: 我不会这么轻易死的。
lines.en: I won't die that easily.

lines.zh: 你撞上我了。
lines.en: You collided with me.

lines.zh: 别碰到我剥落的石壳。
lines.en: Don't touch my flaking stone shell.

lines.zh: 你太接近我了。
lines.en: You're too close to me.

lines.zh: 不要碰我。
lines.en: Do not touch me.

lines.zh: 我不会让你碰的。
lines.en: I won't let you touch me.

lines.zh: 你撞疼我了。
lines.en: You hit me hard.

lines.zh: 离我远点！
lines.en: Stay away from me!

lines.zh: 你撞到我了。
lines.en: You bumped into me.

lines.zh: 洞穴深处，我一直在看。
lines.en: Deep in the cave, I have always watched.

lines.zh: 你触碰到了我。
lines.en: You touched me.

lines.zh: 我裂开的石缝里，想要个伴。
lines.en: In my cracked seams I want a companion.

lines.zh: 寻找另一半。
lines.en: Find your other half.

lines.zh: 我需要一个同伴。
lines.en: I need a companion.

lines.zh: 我想要个伴侣。
lines.en: I want a mate.

lines.zh: 石像也要有伴。
lines.en: Even a statue wants company.

lines.zh: 石像的怀抱空了很久。
lines.en: My stone embrace has been empty too long.

lines.zh: 石头里的我，需要一个伴。
lines.en: The me inside this stone wants company.

lines.zh: 我需要一个配偶。
lines.en: I need a mate.

lines.zh: 它在石堆里寻找同类的轮廓。
lines.en: It searches the rubble for another shape like itself.

lines.zh: 雕像想拼出一个同伴。
lines.en: The statue wants to piece together a companion.

lines.zh: 沉重的石像突然动了！
lines.en: The heavy statue suddenly moves!

lines.zh: 它的眼中燃起了怨恨之火！
lines.en: Hate burns in its eyes!

lines.zh: 雕像的双手在黑暗中缓缓张开！
lines.en: The statue’s hands slowly stretch out in the darkness!

lines.zh: 石像的呼吸声渗入你的骨髓！
lines.en: The statue’s breath seeps into your bones!

lines.zh: 洞穴深处传来低沉的呢喃！
lines.en: A deep whisper echoes from the cave!

lines.zh: 石像开始慢慢转动头部！
lines.en: The statue slowly turns its head!

lines.zh: 雕像的身躯散发出冰冷的气息！
lines.en: The statue exudes a cold aura!

lines.zh: 它似乎察觉了你的存在！
lines.en: It seems to sense your presence!

lines.zh: 石像伸出手臂向你抓来！
lines.en: The statue reaches out with its arms!

lines.zh: 雕像发出刺耳的嘎吱声！
lines.en: The statue emits a piercing creak!

lines.zh: 你被石像盯上了！
lines.en: The statue is fixated on you!

lines.zh: 你成为了它的猎物！
lines.en: You are its prey!

lines.zh: 石像开始追踪你！
lines.en: The statue is tracking you!

lines.zh: 它已经锁定了你的位置！
lines.en: It has locked onto your position!

lines.zh: 石像的视线聚焦在你身上！
lines.en: The statue’s gaze focuses on you!

lines.zh: 你无法逃脱它的视线！
lines.en: You can’t escape its gaze!

lines.zh: 石像开始悄悄靠近！
lines.en: The statue is slowly approaching!

lines.zh: 它准备好了猎杀你！
lines.en: It is ready to hunt you!

lines.zh: 你被石像盯紧了！
lines.en: You are tightly fixed by the statue!

lines.zh: 石像锁定并盯紧你！
lines.en: The statue locks on and fixes you!

lines.zh: 地下的时间到了，它选中了你。
lines.en: Its time underground has come, and it picks you.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸成了它的坐标。
lines.en: Your breathing has become its coordinates.

lines.zh: 它从祭坛上下来，目标是你。
lines.en: It steps down from the altar, and you are the target.

lines.zh: 雕像把你登记进了它的名单。
lines.en: The statue writes you into its list.

lines.zh: 你走得太深，它开始找你。
lines.en: You went too deep, and it starts hunting you.

lines.zh: 它锁定了洞底唯一的活物。
lines.en: It locks onto the only living thing at the cave floor.

lines.zh: 石像将你视为威胁！
lines.en: The statue sees you as a threat!

lines.zh: 石像的攻击即将降临！
lines.en: The statue’s attack is coming down!

lines.zh: 它准备对你发起攻击！
lines.en: It is preparing to attack you!

lines.zh: 石像的攻击即将开始！
lines.en: The statue’s attack is about to begin!

lines.zh: 你感受到了石像的威胁！
lines.en: You feel the threat of the statue!

lines.zh: 石像瞄准了你！
lines.en: The statue is targeting you!

lines.zh: 它的攻击即将命中！
lines.en: Its attack is about to hit you!

lines.zh: 石像的目标是你！
lines.en: You are the statue’s target!

lines.zh: 石像即将对你发起攻击！
lines.en: The statue is about to attack you!

lines.zh: 它对你虎视眈眈！
lines.en: It is eying you with malice!

lines.zh: 它抬起石臂，瞄准你的影子。
lines.en: It raises a stone arm and aims at your shadow.

lines.zh: 它的指节对准了你的胸口。
lines.en: Its knuckles line up with your chest.

lines.zh: 雕像正在挑选落下的角度。
lines.en: The statue is choosing the angle to fall from.

lines.zh: 洞穴的出口被它的身体挡住了。
lines.en: Its body has blocked the cave exit.

lines.zh: 它把斧刃般的裂缝转向你。
lines.en: It turns its blade-like cracks toward you.

lines.zh: 它在计算压下来的距离。
lines.en: It is calculating how far to bring its weight down.

lines.zh: 你的火把照出它举起的拳头。
lines.en: Your torch reveals the fist it has raised.

lines.zh: 它退半步，只为撞得更狠。
lines.en: It steps back half a pace to hit harder.

lines.zh: 石屑从它肩上落下，攻击将至。
lines.en: Stone dust falls from its shoulder; the blow is coming.

lines.zh: 它绕开石块，直直朝你来。
lines.en: It skirts the boulders and comes straight at you.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，锋利的爪子划破空气。
lines.en: Sibilant hiss, sharp claws slicing through the air.

lines.zh: 露出獠牙，盯着你的眼睛。
lines.en: Bared fangs, locking onto your eyes.

lines.zh: 从洞穴深处，爬出阴森的触手。
lines.en: Slithering tentacles emerge from the cave's depths.

lines.zh: 张开嘴巴，露出一排利齿。
lines.en: Opens its mouth, revealing a row of sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 挥舞巨大钳子，试图夹住你。
lines.en: Swings massive claws, trying to clasp you.

lines.zh: 吐出毒液，腐蚀你的皮肤。
lines.en: Exudes venom, corroding your skin.

lines.zh: 用尖刺敲击地面，发出警告。
lines.en: Rattles its spikes against the ground, issuing a warning.

lines.zh: 伸出长舌，舔舐你的脸。
lines.en: Extends its long tongue, lapping at your face.

lines.zh: 挥动巨大螯肢，准备攻击。
lines.en: Wields its massive pincers, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 释放毒素，使你陷入昏迷。
lines.en: Releases toxins, inducing a coma.

lines.zh: 石拳砸在矿道壁上，碎石溅开。
lines.en: Its stone fist smashes the shaft wall, spraying rubble.

lines.zh: 它一掌拍下，地面塌出坑。
lines.en: It slams a palm down and the floor caves into a pit.

lines.zh: 雕像撞过来，把你按在岩壁。
lines.en: The statue charges and pins you to the rock.

lines.zh: 它甩动裂纹的躯干，横扫洞穴。
lines.en: It swings its cracked body across the cave.

lines.zh: 石指扣住你的肩，冷得像冰。
lines.en: Stone fingers clamp your shoulder, cold as ice.

lines.zh: 它砸下的地方，正好是你刚站处。
lines.en: It strikes exactly where you stood a moment ago.

lines.zh: 从黑暗中，缓慢蠕动而出。
lines.en: Slowly slithering out of the darkness.

lines.zh: 洞穴深处，隐约出现一抹阴影。
lines.en: A shadowy figure appears from the depths of the cave.

lines.zh: 突然出现在你的视线中。
lines.en: Suddenly pops into your line of sight.

lines.zh: 悄无声息地，从石缝中爬出。
lines.en: Silently emerging from the cracks in the stone.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，一对红眼闪烁。
lines.en: Two red eyes blink in the darkness.

lines.zh: 潜伏在洞穴的阴影里。
lines.en: Lurking in the shadows of the cave.

lines.zh: 在洞穴深处，缓缓蠕动。
lines.en: Slowly slithering in the depths of the cave.

lines.zh: 从黑暗中，缓缓浮现。
lines.en: Slowly emerging from the darkness.

lines.zh: 从石缝中，悄无声息地钻出。
lines.en: Sneaking out from the cracks in the stone.

lines.zh: 在洞穴深处，无声地移动。
lines.en: Moving silently in the depths of the cave.

lines.zh: 你挖穿岩层，它已在对面站着。
lines.en: You break through the rock and it is already standing there.

lines.zh: 三天之后，洞里的雕像换了位置。
lines.en: Three days later, the statue in the cave has moved.

lines.zh: 火把熄灭，那里多了一尊石像。
lines.en: Your torch dies, and a statue now stands there.

lines.zh: 它从你身后的岔道走出来。
lines.en: It walks out of the side tunnel behind you.

lines.zh: 洞穴的规则，又多了一条。
lines.en: The cave's rules have grown by one more.

lines.zh: 你听见石屑落地，才回头。
lines.en: You hear stone dust fall before you turn around.

lines.zh: 雕像从岩尘中挺起身。
lines.en: The statue straightens up out of the rock dust.

lines.zh: 它在你挖开的洞口等着。
lines.en: It waits at the opening you just dug.

lines.zh: 深处的雕像，第一次抬头。
lines.en: Deep below, the statue raises its head for the first time.

lines.zh: 你越往下，它越像真的。
lines.en: The deeper you go, the more real it looks.

lines.zh: 火焰在皮肤上燃烧，嘶嘶声更加刺耳。
lines.en: Flames burn skin, hisses sharper.

lines.zh: 跌落时嘶嘶声戛然而止。
lines.en: Hiss stops suddenly from fall.

lines.zh: 水淹没时嘶嘶声消失。
lines.en: Hiss stops under water.

lines.zh: 爆炸声中嘶嘶声变得模糊。
lines.en: Hiss muffled by explosion.

lines.zh: 被射弹击中时嘶嘶声消失。
lines.en: Hiss stops from projectile.

lines.zh: 受到魔法攻击时嘶嘶声中断。
lines.en: Hiss stops from magic.

lines.zh: 饥饿时嘶嘶声变得有气无力。
lines.en: Hiss weakens with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷击时嘶嘶声戛然而止。
lines.en: Hiss stops from lightning.

lines.zh: 掉入虚无中嘶嘶声消失。
lines.en: Hiss stops in void.
